hero.title: Great food, memorable moments.
hero.text: Mediterranean cuisine with Spanish soul, seasonal produce and a serene atmosphere to enjoy without rush.

intro.title: Quiet elegance, authentic flavour.
intro.text: Rio de Gusto was born to bring together the best of the Catalan coast and Spanish tradition: honest dishes, warm service and a dining room designed for conversation, celebration and return.

01.title: Market produce
01.text: Fish, vegetables and meats selected weekly with a seasonal approach.

02.title: Mediterranean rhythm
02.text: A flexible menu for bright lunches, long dinners and leisurely after-meals.

03.title: Refined details
03.text: Natural textures, sober tableware and small golden accents in every experience.

combinats.title: Combined dishes
combinats.desc: With french fries; salad available as alternative.

tapas.desc: Classic tapas to share before your meal or with a drink.
